# Make It Land

> Make It Land is a positioning-led brand and web studio for founder-led businesses. The work starts by clarifying what makes a business the obvious choice, then turns that into the brand, messaging, and custom website needed to express it. It is the independent studio of Nicole Miñoza, who spent 23 years at Adobe, most recently as Director of Marketing and Product for Adobe Fonts. The studio takes on one or two engagements at a time. Built to be chosen, not just seen.

## Who it is for
Founders and independent leaders, independent experts, and small teams whose business is already credible but whose positioning, website, or story has not caught up. It is especially useful when the founder is still central to why customers buy. Clients do not need to have their positioning figured out first; positioning is part of the work.

## Services
- Positioning: finding the one overlooked thing that makes a business the obvious choice, and making it the center of everything.
- The site: a custom website designed and built to make the decision easy for whoever is choosing, and to move them from interest to yes.
- The proof: case studies built around evidence, covering what happened, what changed, and what it was worth.

## Engagements and pricing
- Most projects include positioning, messaging, and a custom website. Typical scope is 5–8 pages, and projects usually run over several weeks.
- Engagements start at $8,500; most projects are around $16,000, depending on scope.
- Start smaller: a site review and positioning packet is $1,500 and can be credited toward a larger build started within 60 days.
- Location: based in the Seattle area; works with clients outside it.

## Core pages
- [Home](https://makeitland.studio/): what the studio does, who it is for, how engagements work, and a short FAQ.
- [The Thesis](https://makeitland.studio/thesis.html): the studio's core belief. Visibility is cheap, preference is not; being chosen is a design problem, not a volume problem.

## Selected work
- [My Camino Financial](https://makeitland.studio/work/my-camino-financial.html): client case study. Positioning, copy, and a new site for the money mentor Leslie Roulias,, who had fifteen years of track record and none of it on the page.
- [Adobe: the overlooked thing, made measurable](https://makeitland.studio/work/adobe.html): the founder's track record, not a client engagement. Leading marketing and product for Adobe Fonts. Reported results: more than 12M monthly active users (December 2025); 66% lower monthly churn among Creative Cloud all-app subscribers who adopted Adobe Fonts (causal analysis, March 2025); 186% free-to-paid lift in Adobe Express from redesigned font recommendations (2025).
- [Cuppa Lumpia](https://makeitland.studio/work/cuppa-lumpia.html): a studio-owned venture, not a client project. A 50-year family lumpia recipe, sold from a weekend driveway stand on Bainbridge Island, built like a brand: naming, identity, packaging, signage, and an order site.

## Also from the studio
- [House Style](https://makeitland.studio/work/house-style.html): a shipped product, a curated library of 40+ opinionated AI prompts for brand, marketing, and product leaders. [Open the library](https://housestyle.makeitland.studio/).
- [How Institutions Behave](https://makeitland.studio/work/how-institutions-behave.html): summary page for an interactive thesis benchmarking nine landmark cultural-institution rebrands. Brand is behavior, not image. The full piece is at [How Institutions Behave, interactive](https://makeitland.studio/how-institutions-behave/).

## Writing
- [Better Than What I Planned](https://makeitland.studio/writing/better-than-what-i-planned.html): an essay by Nicole Miñoza on twenty-three years at Adobe, a career break with no plan, and what a linocut tool, a dance class, and a lumpia stand taught her about leadership.
